_comment: Failure drills (afs-drill). Each breaks one thing on a throwaway branch and names the check that must catch it. Paths come from the target's own profile and install record, never from one project.

drills.why: A hand edit to an installed harness file is caught.
A runtime that drifts from the profile's target stacks is caught before any gate runs.
A test service the agents can't wait for is caught (ADR-0016).
A source graph that no longer describes the pinned source is caught (ADR-0019).
A stacked PR whose base is behind the default branch is caught before its CI is trusted.
A human sign-off written by anyone but an approver's review is caught (ADR-0031).

drills.why: A graph run asked for an entry point that doesn't exist stops before any LLM call.
The acceptance workflow fails when a profile gate fails.
A session that forgets its return file is sent back by the stop hook and commits it itself (ADR-0034).
